name: Skill-loss demotion
rule: A live strategy returns to paper when its benchmark-relative proper-score skill stops being positive at the pre-registered confidence
trigger: rolling Brier skill lower bound versus the do-nothing benchmark falls below zero
evidence_required: committed grade rows with official results links
status: pre-registered design - not yet active (no strategy is live)

name: Drawdown demotion
rule: A live strategy returns to paper when its realised drawdown exceeds the stake-plan limit it registered
trigger: peak-to-trough bankroll drawdown breaches the pre-registered fraction
evidence_required: settled stake ledger with closing prices (blocked on BL-01 price capture)
status: pre-registered design - blocked on price-data policy

name: Staleness demotion
rule: A live strategy returns to paper when any input feed it registered goes stale beyond its own freshness bound
trigger: newest official read older than the strategy's registered freshness bound
evidence_required: dated source reads with clock times (the read lineage this site publishes)
status: pre-registered design - active as a rule

name: Pre-registration break demotion
rule: A live strategy returns to paper immediately if any frozen input, rule text or hash fails its integrity check
trigger: hash mismatch or silent rule edit found by the build
evidence_required: git commit hash as the registration record (BL-70)
status: pre-registered design - active as a rule

name: Two-sided gate requirement
rule: Every gate carries both a clearing number and a demotion number; a gate with only a promotion side cannot be used to promote
trigger: gate registered without a demotion side
evidence_required: gate register row with both thresholds (this file supplies the missing side, FL-86)
status: pre-registered design - closes the one-sided gap

name: Re-promotion window
rule: A demoted strategy cannot return to live for at least the re-registration window, and returns under a new pre-registration id
trigger: first decision of the new registration
evidence_required: fresh pre-registration committed before the window opens
